picks.summary:

Mike relates these to us and identifies how we can truly worship and serve the Lord throughout our daily lives. Today’s readings are Catechism paragraphs 2095-2103.

picks.title: #12912 What Is Vatican II? Church Changes and Eucharistic Respect - William Albrecht
picks.summary:
“What is Vatican II?” This episode clarifies the council’s significance, addressing questions like how to explain it simply and why some Catholics believe its directives aren’t mandatory. The discussion also touches on concerns about church closures, the decline in priest numbers, and the perceived lack of respect for the Eucharist following the council’s reforms.

Additionally, the conversation touches on the belief in the real presence of Christ in the Eucharist.

picks.showTitle: Sunday Homilies with Fr. Mike Schmitz
picks.title: 09/27/26 Blind Spots: Complaint
picks.summary: Homily from the Twenty-sixth Sunday in Ordinary Time Training ourselves to notice the negative. Many of us have a default stance to notice the negative. When it comes to our assessment of ourselves or of any given situation, our default setting can often be complaint. And yet God calls us to rise above, to stop noticing the negative and begin approaching His world with wonder and praise. Mass Readings from September 27, 2026: Ezekiel 18:25-28 Psalms 25:4-9Philippians 2:1-11 Matthew 21:28-32]]>
picks.reason: Homily encouraging positive spiritual perspective beyond complaint in Catholic life.

picks.showTitle: The Catechism in a Year (with Fr. Mike Schmitz)
picks.title: Day 267: The Church as Mother and Teacher (2026)
picks.summary:
“The moral life is spiritual worship,” says the Catechism. From the Church, we receive moral guidance, with the Magisterium safeguarding and passing down authentic Christian moral teaching through the generations. This teaching reminds us who we are and how we should be, though it may sometimes deeply challenge us. In its prophetic role, Fr. Mike tells us, “the Church must both console and convict.” Today’s readings are Catechism paragraphs 2030-2036.

picks.title: Praying with St. Padre Pio
picks.summary:

Join Father Tegha Afuhwi Nji and Dr. Jessica Ewell for this final episode in the monthly series Praying with the Saints. Rev. Tegha Afuhwi Nji is an assistant professor of theology at the Augustine Institute Graduate School of Theology. Learn more at Augustine.edu.
